Some blocks fill the air around them with gas. Gases drift around, slowly fade away, and a gas mask with a filter protects you from all of them - at the cost of filter durability.

- §6Radon Gas§r seeps from uranium ores and corebblestone. It is mildly radioactive and harms your lungs.
- §6Dense Radon Gas§r is much worse and gives a radiation effect.
- §6Tomb Gas§r leaks from §6Ancient Scrap Metal§r. It strips away Rad-X and RadAway effects.
- §6Core Gas§r comes out of reactor wrecks: strong radiation and lung damage.
- §6Carbon Monoxide§r leaks from Nether coal ore.
- §6Airborne Asbestos Particles§r and §6Airborne Coal Dust§r are released when you mine asbestos and coal. Breathing them in causes asbestosis and black lung.
- §6Explosive Gas§r and §6Flammable Gas§r fill gas pockets underground and catch fire or explode.
